sv.title: Polisen utreder misstänkt dataintrång hos taxibolag
sv.summary: Polisen utreder ett misstänkt dataintrång mot taxibolag. Enligt uppgifter till TT rör intrånget Cabonline, som äger bland annat Taxikurir.

en.title: Police investigate suspected data breach at taxi company
en.summary: Police are investigating a suspected data breach against a taxi company. According to information to TT, the breach concerns Cabonline, which owns among others Taxikurir.
